messages:
maria: Hey team — Celmora just returned the vendor risk form. Main asks: BYOK/KMS proof, embedding retention policy, and non-prod data handling. They want answers by EOD Friday. :eyes:
lawrence: Can you paste the exact KMS question? If it's BYOK provenance we can point them at our KMS matrix and SOC2 control docs.
ajay: Quick clarifying q — are they planning to ingest customer PII in embeddings or only hashed identifiers?
maria: Quote from form: 'Do you support customer-managed keys for encryption at rest? Provide key provenance and CMK rotation details.'
sam: FYI they selected "Hosted API" on the onboarding worksheet but mentioned an enterprise security review is required. Might escalate to Dedicated if BYOK required.
lawrence: Ok. Action plan: 1) share our KMS integration doc + rotation cadence 2) confirm embedding retention policy 3) note non-prod masking + access controls. I can draft KMS blurb.
security-bot: sec-review created: SR-4521 assigned to lawrence — due 2026-03-27.
maria: I'll pull the evidence links and a short template reply. Draft answers should be limited — customers prefer short bullets.
ajay: For embeddings retention: suggest we provide two options: default (30d ephemeral KV cache) vs enterprise contract (custom retention + purge). Also note we support pseudonymization.
lawrence: Draft snippet for BYOK: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) for Private deployments and Dedicated with KMS integration. Key provenance: customer-owned CMKs used for disk encryption; rotation is performed by customer or via supported KMS lifecycle; audit logs available in KMS and our audit export." Thoughts?
maria: That reads fine. Can you add a one-liner about evidence: link to our SOC2 artifact + KMS integration runbook.
lawrence: Added: "See SOC2 control pack (link) and KMS integration runbook: https://redwood.docs/internal/kms-runbook — provide CSV of key IDs when requested."
sam: I'll coordinate with the customer to confirm whether they need key escrow or just attestations.
ajay: Minor: include the embeddings purge command we run for enterprise customers:
```
# run on infra-admin
python scripts/purge_embeddings.py --tenant celmora --retain-days 0
```
maria: Perfect. I'll assemble a short reply and send to Celmora, then post back here. 
 tickets-bot: Ticket TCK-8819 created for Celmora onboarding follow-up.
maria: Sending now — I'll tag the thread with the ticket and SR. Will loop back when they reply. :thumbsup:
lawrence: Thanks — once they accept, we should schedule a 30-min tech call to walk the copy of the evidence.
ajay: +1, prep a one-page tech summary for that call.
maria: Noted. Owners: lawrence (KMS blurb + SOC2 links), ajay (embeddings retention + purge snippet), sam (customer coordination). Target: EOD Friday.
